How much is a used MacBook Air M1 worth?

The MacBook Air M1 (2020) is still one of the most sought-after used laptops. In Europe one detail often gets overlooked: the keyboard layout.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The Apple menu, About This Mac shows the chip, memory and serial. The M1 Air has no fan, two USB-C ports and a wedge shape. The M2 Air (2022) is flat, has MagSafe and sells for more.

What decides the price

  • Memory and storage: 8 GB and 256 GB is the base model; 16 GB or 512 GB sells for more.
  • Battery: the cycle count is shown in System Information, Power.
  • Keyboard layout: a German QWERTZ or French AZERTY keyboard limits buyers in other countries. Sell where the layout is local.
  • Condition: dents, screen coating wear, keyboard shine.
  • Charger: an original charger is expected.

Check before you buy

  • Find My Mac must be off and the Mac erased (no Activation Lock).
  • Check memory, storage and battery cycles.
  • Test every key, the trackpad, the camera and both ports.
  • Look for marks on the screen from the keyboard.

Where it sells best

Sells well on eBay and local marketplaces. Sell in the country that matches the keyboard layout to reach the most buyers.

Questions

How much is a used MacBook Air M1 worth?

It depends on memory, storage, battery cycles, keyboard layout and locks. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Apple MacBook Air M1" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Is a MacBook Air M1 with 8 GB still worth buying to resell?

Yes, it is the most common version and still in demand. Compare only with the same memory and storage.

Does the keyboard layout really change the price?

Not the value itself, but the number of buyers. A QWERTZ keyboard sells best in Germany and Austria, AZERTY in France and Belgium.
